instruction: A candid outdoor full shot of a sunny park with lush green grass and leafy trees. On the left, the woman with dark hair tied back (R4) in a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans jumps high in the air with her back partially turned to the camera. On the right, the bald man (R2) in a dark blue t-shirt and black pants jumps facing her. Together, they perform an energetic mid-air double high-five celebration under the bright natural sunlight filtering through the trees.
elements: R4 is the high-five partner whose back is partially turned toward the camera while R2 faces her
R2 jumps facing R4 during the mid-air double high-five
R4 and R2 reciprocally raise their hands toward each other for an energetic double high-five
R4 and R2 are both airborne during the celebration contact
The interaction takes place outdoors in a sunny park with grass and trees
